records.ai_role: The European Commission confirmed attackers used a publicly available AI tool; the specific tool and autonomy level were not confirmed.
records.where: Brussels, Belgium (institutional headquarters; not a confirmed attack origin)
records.decision_reason: Official Commission briefing confirmed AI-assisted cyber campaign and application shutdowns; subsequent EU Academy data leak reported.

severity_evidence.reason: Confirmed protective shutdown of Commission applications and disclosure of EU Academy user names and email addresses; wider data theft not established.

records.title: AI-assisted cyber campaign disrupted European Commission services
records.what: The European Commission confirmed an AI-assisted cyber campaign detected October 22. Several applications were taken offline as a protective measure. Subsequent reporting confirmed EU Academy user data was leaked; the extent remains under investigation.
records.significance: AI-assisted attack disrupted European Commission applications; separate EU Academy user-data leakage was confirmed in follow-up reporting.
